original_ai_output.title_zh: 莫桑比克：三名渔民从恐怖分子扣押中逃脱
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据当地消息源向独立媒体《Carta de Moçambique》透露，三名渔民在德尔加杜角省莫辛布瓦-达普拉亚地区所乘船只被劫持后遭恐怖分子扣押，上周三成功逃脱。这些渔民属于此前被绑架的20人团伙，绑架发生在莫桑比克海军击毙至少三名恐怖分子的军事冲突前不久。消息源称，被扣押者曾被关押在梅萨洛河附近。

location.raw_text: Mocímboa da Praia district, northern Mozambican province of Cabo Delgado; vicinity of the Messalo River

key_facts.fact: 三名渔民在莫辛布瓦-达普拉亚地区船只被劫持后遭恐怖分子扣押并逃脱
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A group of three fishermen escaped from captivity at the hands of terrorists last Wednesday after the vessel they were on was hijacked in Mocímboa da Praia district

key_facts.fact: 逃脱的渔民属于此前被绑架的20名渔民团伙
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the men who escaped from the terrorists were part of a group of 20 fishermen abducted shortly before a military clash

key_facts.fact: 军事冲突中至少三名恐怖分子被莫桑比克海军击毙
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a military clash that resulted in the deaths of at least three terrorists, who were killed by the Mozambican Navy

key_facts.fact: 被扣押渔民曾被关押在梅萨洛河附近
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the fishermen were held captive in the vicinity of the Messalo River

key_facts.fact: ACLED称8月至9月间发生11起针对平民社区的袭击，其中涉及绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Over the months of August and September, eleven attacks on civilian communities involved abductions

uncertainties: 事件细节主要依据当地消息源，目前仅单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
被绑架渔民总数及逃脱人数尚未获独立确认
恐怖分子身份与所属组织未获官方确认
